incidents.sourceName: STT report citing Finnish Ministry of Defence and Border Guard
incidents.investigationStatus: Finnish Border Guard and Police investigation; possible territorial violation under investigation
incidents.summary: Fixed-wing UAV recovered near Porvoo/Pellinge, Finland. Preliminary assessment indicates mapping or surveillance use. No explosive payload reported. Origin and operator remain unknown. Possible territorial violation under investigation.

evidence.observed: Physical fixed-wing UAV recovered; several metres in size; authorities reported no explosive payload.
evidence.assessed: Preliminary mapping or surveillance function; exact role remains under investigation.
